## Specification

### Component: Description list

Term / details pairs on a native `<dl>`: customer profile, invoice meta, settings summary. Presentational and Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
```
<DescriptionList orientation divided labelWidth>   <dl class="ui-dl">  (container-type: inline-size)
  <DescriptionItem>                                <div class="ui-dl-item">
    <DescriptionTerm />                            <dt class="ui-dl-term">
    <DescriptionDetails />                         <dd class="ui-dl-details">
```

#### Props
- `DescriptionList`: `orientation` (`stacked` default | `horizontal`), `divided` (hairline between items), `labelWidth` (CSS length for the label column, default `11rem`).

#### Visual rules
- 14px / 1.5. Term: `--ui-muted-foreground`, 500. Details: `--ui-foreground`, regular, wraps anywhere (long emails, ids). An empty `<dd>` shows an em dash.
- Items 10px vertical padding (12px when `divided`); first and last trim their outer padding unless divided. Divider: 1px `--ui-border-subtle`, none under the last item.
- `horizontal`: once the **list** (not the viewport) is ≥ 32rem wide, each item becomes a two-column grid — label column, 16px gap, details — baseline-aligned. Narrower, it stacks. Works inside a Card at any width.

#### Motion
- None.

#### Accessibility
- Native `dl` / `dt` / `dd` with `<div>` grouping (valid HTML). Details may contain badges, links or a CopyButton.

#### Acceptance checks
- In a 360px card the list stacks; in a 720px card the label column appears.
- Dividers do not double up with the card border; no horizontal overflow with a 60-character email.

## Files

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

### `ui/components/description-list/description-list.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type DescriptionListOrientation = 'stacked' | 'horizontal';

export interface DescriptionListProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDListElement> {
  /**
   * `stacked`: term above details. `horizontal`: term in a label column beside the details once
   * the list is wide enough (≈ 512px), stacked below that. Default `stacked`.
   */
  orientation?: DescriptionListOrientation;
  /** A hairline between items. */
  divided?: boolean;
  /** Width of the label column in `horizontal` (CSS length). Default `11rem`. */
  labelWidth?: string;
}

/**
 * DescriptionList — a native `<dl>` of term / details pairs (customer profile, invoice meta).
 * Sizes itself to its container, so it works full-width or inside a Card. Server Component–safe.
 * Compose: DescriptionItem > DescriptionTerm + DescriptionDetails.
 */
export const DescriptionList = forwardRef<HTMLDListElement, DescriptionListProps>(function DescriptionList(
  { orientation = 'stacked', divided = false, labelWidth, className, style, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const merged = labelWidth ? ({ '--ui-dl-label': labelWidth, ...style } as CSSProperties) : style;
  return (
    <dl
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-dl', orientation === 'horizontal' && 'ui-dl-horizontal', divided && 'ui-dl-divided', className)}
      style={merged}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/** One term + details pair. Renders a `<div>`, which `<dl>` allows for grouping. */
export const DescriptionItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function DescriptionItem(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-dl-item', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The label: "Email", "Billing plan". */
export const DescriptionTerm = forwardRef<HTMLElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>(function DescriptionTerm(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <dt ref={ref} className={cn('ui-dl-term', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The value. Can hold text, a Badge, a link or a CopyButton. */
export const DescriptionDetails = forwardRef<HTMLElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>(function DescriptionDetails(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <dd ref={ref} className={cn('ui-dl-details', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/description-list.css`

```css
/* Description list --------------------------------------------------------
   <dl class="ui-dl [ui-dl-horizontal] [ui-dl-divided]">
     <div class="ui-dl-item"><dt class="ui-dl-term"/><dd class="ui-dl-details"/></div>
   Container-sized: horizontal puts the term in a label column once the list is ≥ 32rem wide.
   --ui-dl-label sets the label column width.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-dl {
    --ui-dl-label: 11rem;
    container-type: inline-size;
    display: grid;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .ui-dl-item {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding-block: 0.625rem;
  }
  .ui-dl-item:first-child { padding-top: 0; }
  .ui-dl-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }

  .ui-dl-term {
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .ui-dl-details {
    margin: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .ui-dl-details:empty::before { content: '—'; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  .ui-dl-divided > .ui-dl-item { padding-block: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }
  .ui-dl-divided > .ui-dl-item:first-child { padding-top: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-dl-divided > .ui-dl-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0.75rem; border-bottom-color: transparent; }

  @container (min-width: 32rem) {
    .ui-dl-horizontal > .ui-dl-item {
      grid-template-columns: var(--ui-dl-label) minmax(0, 1fr);
      column-gap: 1rem;
      align-items: baseline;
    }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Customer details** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/description-list/customer.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { CopyButton } from '@/ui/components/copy-button';
import { DescriptionDetails, DescriptionItem, DescriptionList, DescriptionTerm } from '@/ui/components/description-list';

export default function CustomerDetails() {
  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-2xl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Customer details</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Account and billing information for Northwind Traders.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <DescriptionList orientation="horizontal" divided>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Primary contact</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails>Amara Okafor</DescriptionDetails>
          </DescriptionItem>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Email</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails>
              <a className="underline underline-offset-4" href="mailto:amara.okafor@northwind.example">
                amara.okafor@northwind.example
              </a>
            </DescriptionDetails>
          </DescriptionItem>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Customer ID</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <code className="font-mono text-[13px]">cus_9sK2mQ4xT7</code>
                <CopyButton value="cus_9sK2mQ4xT7" aria-label="Copy customer ID" size="xs" />
              </span>
            </DescriptionDetails>
          </DescriptionItem>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Plan</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails>
              Scale, billed annually <Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
            </DescriptionDetails>
          </DescriptionItem>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Billing address</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails>
              214 Harbor Street, Suite 5
              <br />
              Rotterdam 3011 AB, Netherlands
            </DescriptionDetails>
          </DescriptionItem>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Customer since</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails>March 12, 2023</DescriptionDetails>
          </DescriptionItem>
          <DescriptionItem>
            <DescriptionTerm>Purchase order</DescriptionTerm>
            <DescriptionDetails />
          </DescriptionItem>
        </DescriptionList>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
